input: i want to do a bunch of predictive models for individual catholic profiles on beliefs especially relating to marriage related beleifs and outcomes and adherance to catholic teaching. devotional levels. learning associations with the models and being able to predict lacking information. also on sub cultures within protestant orthodox and catholic. in the us and globablly and immigrant populations.
errors: First full run crashed in the temporal hold-out: an all-missing feature column in a pre-2014 training split broke HistGradientBoosting binning; fixed by dropping never-observed columns per split and rerun.

Crossref 429s skip about a third of lookups in one burst; a short backoff-and-retry would turn SKIPs into verdicts.

deviations.why: A sibling open PR (#12893, catholic-demography) covers Catholic subgroup levels.
